summary: Iter 32 — System 'School Notifications' virtual peer + group mute + group pin, plus full chat regression (iter29/30/31) and broad app regression across auth/students/attendance/fees/sick_leaves/holidays/academic/notifications/trips/uploads. Backend: 67/67 pass — 52/52 across all four messaging suites (test_messaging.py 12, test_iter30_messaging_v2.py 10, test_iter31_groups_updates.py 14, test_iter32_system_peer_pin_mute.py 16) and 15/15 broad regression (test_iter32_app_regression.py). Frontend (parent+teacher+admin): single-pane chat list (NO Updates tab, role='tab' count=0 for all 3 roles), 'School Notifications' rendered as a direct contact at top with school building avatar (chat-avatar-system), opening it shows TELEGRAM channel header bubbles + 'School channel · WhatsApp / Telegram mirror · Read-only · Last 7 shown' subheader + locked composer; teacher opening Grade 5 A — Parents group shows send button + input + mute button + pin button + pin banner; admin sees All Teachers (Broadcast) group + School Notifications + 3 teacher direct contacts; 0 page errors across 3 dashboards.
action_items: (nit, carry-over from iter31) routes/messaging.py send_message has an unreachable duplicate 'return out_msg' near line 613 — harmless dead code, worth tidying when next touched.

(nit) routes/messaging.py /groups/{id}/mute and /pin endpoints share a permission check pattern with the conversation-level mute — consider extracting an _assert_group_member helper to DRY the 5 callsites.

(nit) The /api/calendar route from frontend nav was not wired for teacher dashboard side-nav and silently routed back to /teacher (no error, no broken UI). Verify that teacher Calendar is intentionally hidden from sidebar or wire the link if expected.
critical_code_review_comments: messaging.py SYSTEM_PEER_ID constant is the string 'system::school-notifications'. _system_contact() / _chat_update_to_message() / list_contacts / list_messages / mark_read / get_conv_settings all key off this single constant — clean single source of truth. Verified that the conv_id on synthesized messages echoes SYSTEM_PEER_ID, sender_id is also SYSTEM_PEER_ID, channel field is preserved end-to-end (telegram/whatsapp/email/sms).

messaging.py list_messages for the system peer marks chat_updates as read inside the same handler. Behaviour is correct (mirrors how the user opens the thread) but it means a passive GET has a write side-effect. Acceptable for an in-app inbox; just be aware of it for any future polling.

messaging.py POST /groups/{id}/pin uses Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=168) so hours=0/-1/200 correctly return 422. pinned_until is computed as utc_now() + timedelta(hours=hours) and serialised via .isoformat() — verified delta is within (23.5, 24.5)h for default. After unpin the $unset removes all 6 pin keys cleanly.

messaging.py group pin/unpin broadcasts type='group_pin' to every member via manager.send_to_user. Owner is double-sent (once in members loop, once explicit) — harmless but mildly wasteful for very small groups. Not a bug.
messaging.py list_groups auto-clears expired pins via pin_until < now check on every read — confirmed by code inspection at line 1138 (no separate cron needed).

core/notify.py queue_notification mirror path correctly imports messaging.manager + SYSTEM_PEER_ID + _chat_update_to_message INSIDE the try block (avoiding circular import at module load) and dispatches the WS 'message' event with sender_id=SYSTEM_PEER_ID. Verified via end-to-end direct call (test_mirror_inserts_chat_update_and_dispatches_ws_message).

students.py upload_photo still expects multipart/form-data 'file' UploadFile, validates size, base64-encodes into a data URL, and stores in tdb.students.photo. No Azure/object storage. Test harness updated to send multipart accordingly.

ChatPage.jsx: tabs are completely removed (role='tab' count==0 for parent/teacher/admin). 'School Notifications' is shown as a direct contact with chat-avatar-system styling; bubbles show TELEGRAM channel header inside (chat-bubble-channel-header); composer is locked (chat-composer-locked). Pin banner (chat-pin-banner) and mute toggle visible in teacher's group header.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the parent/teacher/admin chat + dashboard smokes; 0 page errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: Four messaging backend test files now exist and should be run together as the chat-feature regression: test_messaging.py (iter29, 12), test_iter30_messaging_v2.py (iter30, 10), test_iter31_groups_updates.py (iter31, 14), test_iter32_system_peer_pin_mute.py (iter32, 16). The system peer id is the literal string 'system::school-notifications' — do not URL-encode the colons, requests/FastAPI handle them fine. The mirror test (TestMirrorWsFire) imports from /app/backend directly and uses load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env'); it only works from inside the pod. queue_notification's signature is (school_id, recipient_type, recipient_id, phone, channel, template, message, context=None, email=None, subject=None, telegram_chat_id=None) — DO NOT pass 'body=' (I made that mistake first run; fixed). Pin endpoint accepts hours in [1, 168]; 0/-1/200 return 422 (Pydantic). For the broad app regression note that holidays live at /api/holidays (not /api/calendar/holidays), classes live at /api/academic/classes, notifications log at /api/notifications. Student photo upload is multipart/form-data with field name 'file' (not JSON 'photo'). Frontend: tabs are entirely removed — checking for role='tab' length 0 is the cleanest assertion that no Updates tab exists. Use page.context.clear_cookies() between different role logins or playwright keeps the previous session.
rca of the issue: No issues. All 67 backend tests pass; all chat UI flows verified for parent + teacher + admin with 0 page errors.
